scope: Original A18 timer/bounded-output source-clause composition; no replay
originalValidation: Fake-timer tests for completed-at-open, completion during first read, early abort, cancel, missing job and DB failure. Assert zero active timers after termination. Measure large-output DB reads and bounded per-client work before changing storage.

actualSevenTests.name: SQLite returns bounded Unicode slices/tails from a two-MiB captured job without loading the full field
already-aborted requests do no reads; completion during the first pending read starts no poll timer
completed startup drains bounded Unicode output with backpressure and no polling leak
slow reads never overlap; poll follows completion and fresh authorization revokes before the next DB read
reader cancel and request abort clean timers, unsubscribe and discard late DB results
resume/reset, missing/error/deadline close with fixed errors and clear every timer
log rendering retains a bounded valid-Unicode text tail and strips ANSI without per-event DOM growth

limitations: Disposable SQLite/synthetic Unicode log, no real runner/image
Single uncontrolled observations, not latency/CPU/RSS acceptance
